gloss: reflexive awareness; the Heart knowing its own shining. Abhinavagupta identifies it with para-vac and spanda.
primordial dynamism; the throb of consciousness becoming world. Same pulse as vimarsha at the dynamic register.
the 'I' that contains a...ksa: first phoneme a to last drop m. Felt re-cognition of the self as the Lord.
the Lord's freedom; the one concept answering permanence, idealism, otherness, difference.
felt re-cognition of the already-established self as the Lord; nothing added.
ordered phonemic universe (emission); 50 mothers installed by nyasa across the body.
mixed seeds-and-matrices alphabet (na→pha); the Sakta body (sakta-sarira) installed second.
no-means: grace-only recognition; the ānava end of the upaya ladder.
descent of grace; ninefold (tivra/madhya/manda x utkrsa/madhya/nikrsa); gates initiation.
initiation that installs the deity's powers; follows grace, never replaces it.
upward-motion/utterance: impulse→breath→sound→fading; carried on comfortable breath (ha).
wonder/astonishment at recognition; the felt signature (camatkara) of the real.
light: the shining of manifestation; inseparable from vimarsha (knowing the shining).
reflection: the world as consciousness mirrored in itself; mirror that knows (vs inert mirror).
sixfold course: varna→mantra→pada (vācaka) paired with kala→tattva→bhuvana (vacya).
energy/division of time and cosmos; five cover head to feet (nivrtti→santatita).
principle of reality; 36 from Siva to earth, recapitulated by the body.
world/domain: the object-side pairing of pada (word).
sonic form of the deity; energy whose nature is matrka (Tantrasadbhava via SSV 2.3).
phoneme: unmanifest sound shining in the rising of breath (uccara); successive synthetic awareness (varnaparamarsa).
12-finger space: the course of prana (heart→nasal end) and of udana (heart→crown end); aham spans it.
the esoteric lineage-practice: sequence (krama) and the order-less source of time (Kalis).
the clan-practice: immanent rites of the heart-emission; later Kaula developments.
the three effective means: anava (embodied supports) / sakta (purified thought) / sambhava (direct recognition), keyed to grace intensity.
